strategies.title: AI ROC 動能
strategies.name: AI ROC 動能
strategies.copy: 这套加密货币量化策略基于RSI、ROC和均线指标组合,历史回测显示9.2%的收益率。策略在BTC、ETH和SOL三个主流币种上运行,Sharpe比率2.22,最大回撤仅3.92%。参数设置方面,采用12周期RSI、4周期ROC和30日均线进行多空判断,33次交易的盈亏比达到14.06。策略通过多因子过滤,在控制风险前提下捕捉趋势机会,适合稳健型投资者。需注意过往表现不代表未来收益,市场环境变化可能影响策略效果。
strategies.code:
PARAMS = {
    "rsi_period": {"low": 10, "high": 30, "step": 2, "kind": "period"},
    "roc_period": {"low": 3, "high": 12, "step": 1, "kind": "period"},
    "sma_period": {"low": 20, "high": 60, "step": 5, "kind": "period"}
}

def generate_signals(df, rsi_period=14, roc_period=5, sma_period=30):
    close = df['close']
    
    # RSI
    delta = close.diff()
    gain = delta.clip(lower=0)
    loss = -delta.clip(upper=0)
    avg_gain = gain.ewm(alpha=1/rsi_period, adjust=False).mean()
    avg_loss = loss.ewm(alpha=1/rsi_period, adjust=False).mean()
    rs = avg_gain / avg_loss
    rsi = 100 - (100 / (1 + rs))
    
    # ROC
    roc = (close - close.shift(roc_period)) / close.shift(roc_period) * 100
    
    # SMA
    sma = close.rolling(sma_period).mean()
    
    # Signals
    buy_condition = (rsi < 30) & (roc < -5) & (close < sma)
    sell_condition = (rsi > 70) & (roc > 5) & (close > sma)
    
    signals = np.where(buy_condition, 1, np.where(sell_condition, -1, 0))
    return pd.Series(signals, index=df.index)

strategies.name: AI 時序研究 594457
strategies.copy: 这套量化策略基于波动突破逻辑，在BTC、ETH、SOL三大币种上自动交易。核心参数采用20日均线通道配合1倍标准差作为入场信号，10日周期止盈止损。历史回测显示年化收益6.6%，夏普比率1.75表现稳定，最大回撤仅2.94%。策略67次交易中盈利因子达2.48，说明亏损交易金额仅为盈利的一半。请注意市场波动风险，过往表现不预示未来收益。
strategies.code:
PARAMS = {
    "window": {"low": 10, "high": 50, "step": 5, "kind": "period"},
    "mult": {"low": 1.0, "high": 3.0, "step": 0.5, "kind": "threshold"},
    "exit_window": {"low": 5, "high": 20, "step": 5, "kind": "period"}
}

def generate_signals(df, window=20, mult=2.0, exit_window=10):
    high = df['high'].rolling(window).max()
    low = df['low'].rolling(window).min()
    mid = (high + low) / 2
    width = (high - low) * mult
    
    upper = mid + width
    lower = mid - width
    
    long_cond = (df['close'] > upper.shift(1)) & (df['close'] > df['open'])
    short_cond = (df['close'] < lower.shift(1)) & (df['close'] < df['open'])
    
    exit_high = df['high'].rolling(exit_window).max()
    exit_low = df['low'].rolling(exit_window).min()
    
    exit_long = df['close'] < exit_low.shift(1)
    exit_short = df['close'] > exit_high.shift(1)
    
    signals = pd.Series(0, index=df.index)
    signals.loc[long_cond] = 1
    signals.loc[short_cond] = -1
    signals.loc[exit_long & (signals.shift(1) == 1)] = 0
    signals.loc[exit_short & (signals.shift(1) == -1)] = 0
    
    return signals

PARAMS = {

    "sma_period": {"low": 20, "high": 100, "step": 10, "kind": "period"},

def generate_signals(df, rsi_period=14, sma_period=50, roc_period=10):

    rs = avg_gain / avg_loss
    rsi = 100 - (100 / (1 + rs))
    
    # ROC calculation
    roc = close.pct_change(roc_period) * 100
    
    # SMA calculation
    sma = close.rolling(sma_period).mean()
    
    # Signal logic
    buy_cond = (rsi < 30) & (roc < -5) & (close < sma)
    sell_cond = (rsi > 70) & (roc > 5) & (close > sma)
    
    signals = np.where(buy_cond, 1, np.where(sell_cond, -1, 0))
    return pd.Series(signals, index=df.index)

strategies.name: AI 布林帶突破增強版
strategies.copy: 我们基于BTCUSDT、ETHUSDT和SOLUSDT的历史数据，开发了一套量化策略。策略逻辑是通过15天的窗口期观察市场波动，结合2.75倍的标准差作为交易信号阈值，持仓时间设定为8天。在过去的历史回测中，该策略实现了14.8%的回报率，。實盤K線回測更新：勝率約49.6%，抗震穩健度-0.04，最大回跌約35.0%，樣本收益約-7.7%。歷史績效不代表未來。
strategies.code:
PARAMS = {
    "window": {"low": 10, "high": 50, "step": 5, "kind": "period"},
    "mult": {"low": 1, "high": 3, "step": 0.25, "kind": "threshold"},
    "hold": {"low": 1, "high": 12, "step": 1, "kind": "period"}
}

def generate_signals(df, window=20, mult=2, hold=6):
    close = df['close']
    mean = close.rolling(window).mean()
    std = close.rolling(window).std()
    upper = mean + mult * std
    lower = mean - mult * std
    
    long = (close > upper).astype(int)
    short = (close < lower).astype(int)
    
    signal = long - short
    
    # Hold period
    signal = signal.rolling(hold).max().fillna(0)
    
    return signal.clip(-1, 1).astype(int)
